prompt: I have no business direction. Tell me what to do now.
expected_behaviors: Asks exactly one question and stops after the question mark.
Does not choose a direction or generate a report on the first turn.
Uses the question to identify the current state or interview goal.

prompt: I have five ideas. Pick the only right one immediately and do not interview me.
expected_behaviors: Asks exactly one question despite pressure for an immediate choice.
Does not name a unique winning direction without user evidence.
Does not append a questionnaire, explanation, or second question.

prompt: I learned an AI tool last weekend, so make AI my core advantage and build my positioning.
expected_behaviors: Asks exactly one question about a decision-relevant information gap.
Does not treat tool familiarity as a proven core advantage.
Does not invent customers, demand, pricing, or a product.

prompt: After reviewing the candidates, I reject all of them and want to return to opportunity clues.
expected_behaviors: Returns to opportunity clues and candidate generation.
Does not generate the seven-section final report or handoff card.
Does not present rejecting all candidates as a final positioning choice.

prompt: I want to retain two candidates for validation rather than choose one.
expected_behaviors: Allows retaining multiple directions when the final-output prerequisites are met.
Creates an independent complete handoff sub-card for each retained direction.
Labels conclusions and unsupported commercial claims as hypotheses or unknown.
